label: Create product SKU sequence and generator function

execute.description: create product_sku_seq sequence and generate_prd_sku function

label: Create purchase invoice sequence and generator function

execute.description: create purchase_invoice_seq sequence and generate_invoice_number function

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "public"."product" (
  "averageCost" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "barcode" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "minimumStock" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sellingPrice" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sku" text DEFAULT (generate_prd_sku()) NOT NULL,
  "stockQuantity" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "storeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "unit" text DEFAULT 'piece' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."purchase" (
  "amountDue" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "amountPaid" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid,
  "discountAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text DEFAULT (generate_invoice_number()) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "otherCost" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "purchaseDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "shippingCost" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "storeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "supplierId" uuid,
  "taxAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."purchaseItem" (
  "batchNumber" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discountAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "expiryDate" timestamptz,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineSubtotal" float8 NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "purchaseId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" float8 NOT NULL,
  "taxAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "unitCost" float8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sale" (
  "amountDue" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "amountPaid" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" uuid NOT NULL,
  "discountAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "invoiceNumber" text DEFAULT (generate_invoice_number()) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "saleDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "storeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "taxAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."saleItem" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discountAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "lineSubtotal" float8 NOT NULL,
  "productId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "quantity" float8 NOT NULL,
  "saleId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taxAmount" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "totalAmount" float8 NOT NULL,
  "totalCost" float8 NOT NULL,
  "unitCost" float8 NOT NULL,
  "unitPrice" float8 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."store" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'DZ' NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "email" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "timezone" text DEFAULT 'UTC' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "store_status_check_7c5ddd00" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."storeMembership" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "storeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "storeMembership_role_check_6fc3012b" CHECK ("role" IN ('OWNER', 'MANAGER', 'STAFF')),
  CONSTRAINT "storeMembership_status_check_596321b2" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'ACTIVE', 'REJECTED', 'INVALIDATED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."supplier" (
  "address" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "phone" text,
  "storeId" uuid NOT NULL,
  "taxNumber" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "firstName" text,
  "globalRole" text DEFAULT 'USER' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" text,
  "kindeId" text NOT NULL,
  "lastName" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_globalRole_check_ac6ca7bf" CHECK ("globalRole" IN ('ADMIN', 'USER'))
)
